results.label: thm:exchange
results.title: Exact exchange criterion
results.statement: For n ≥ 3, both exchange optima are attained and F_n is SOS exactly when gamma_n ≤ 1, including singular dual states.
results.explanation: Expresses the unrestricted finite SOS question as the exact attained mixed/pure exchange budget.
results.scope: Written criterion, both optima attained, includes singular dual states and equality gamma=1. Rational strict certificates only for gamma<1.

results.label: thm:criticality
results.title: Criticality of the pure budget
results.statement: The exchange budget obeys 1/2 ≤ gamma_n ≤ 4 and the stated lower bound for n ≥ 128, with a certificate-relative margin consequence.
results.explanation: Explains why feasible certificates approach the critical budget without asserting an unconditional limit equal to one.
results.scope: 1/2 <= gamma_n <= 4; lower bound for n >= 128; certificate-relative margin consequence. No unconditional gamma_n -> 1.

results.label: cor:boundary
results.title: Failure of the all-order increment condition
results.statement: A least non-SOS boundary width κ_* exists; all larger widths and increments R_n for n ≥ max(2,2κ_*-1) fail SOS.
results.explanation: Uses the corner tail decomposition to refute the all-order increment premise.
results.scope: Existence and all-larger-width transfer; the self-contained written proof uses the established F corner and tail identity.

results.label: rem:persistence
results.title: An expectation at moderate orders
results.statement: SOS is expected to persist to moderate orders; no endpoint or extension beyond 50 is proved.
results.explanation: Separates a qualitative expectation from the certified finite positive range and the open transition problem.
results.scope: An expectation without a specified endpoint, not a proved extension of the positive range. Evidence is limited to the shipped exact ambient certificates through order 50 and the normalized tangent defect.
